Il fondo di emergenza è liquidità tenuta: The emergency fund is cash set aside for the unexpected: a breakdown, a medical bill, a period with no income. It covers them without selling investments and without taking on debt.

Anche il debito buono va sostenuto dalla: Even good debt has to be backed by the instalment: if it weighs too much on the budget, it becomes a problem all the same.

Un'obbligazione è un prestito: chi la co: A bond is a loan: whoever buys it lends money to a government or a company. In return they receive periodic interest, the coupons, and at maturity the repayment of the capital, the face value.

Fino alla scadenza l'obbligazione si può: Until maturity the bond can be sold on the market, at a price that rises and falls. Repayment of the face value only comes at the end, and only if the issuer stays solvent.
Quando i tassi di mercato salgono, le nu: When market rates rise, new bonds pay higher coupons: the old one, with its fixed coupon, attracts less and its price falls until its yield lines up. When rates fall the opposite happens.
La duration misura quanto il prezzo di u: Duration measures how much a bond's price reacts to a change in rates. The higher it is, the more the price moves: long-dated bonds swing more than short ones.
Una zero coupon a lunga scadenza restitu: A long-dated zero coupon pays everything back at the end: its duration equals its maturity and it's among the bonds most sensitive to rates.
Il rating è il giudizio sulla solidità d: A rating is a judgement on the issuer's soundness. A low rating signals a higher risk that the issuer won't pay back, and usually a higher yield to make up for it.
Le obbligazioni high yield (ad alto rend: High yield bonds are those with a low rating: they pay more because the risk of default is higher.
Rischio di credito e rischio di tasso so: Credit risk and interest rate risk are two different things. The first is about who pays; the second about how market rates move. A bond from a rock-solid issuer still loses value if rates rise.

Il tasso reale è il tasso nominale meno: The real rate is the nominal rate minus inflation: it tells you how much purchasing power really grows. A 3% rate with inflation at 4% is a negative real rate.

I tassi ufficiali di una valuta li decid: A currency's official rates are set by the central bank. When inflation is high it raises them: mortgages and loans cost more, saving pays more, demand slows and so does the rise in prices.
La curva dei rendimenti mette in fila i: The yield curve lines up rates by maturity. When it's inverted, meaning short rates are above long ones, the market expects lower rates in the future: historically it has often come before a slowdown, but it isn't a clock.
Di solito le obbligazioni aiutano quando: Bonds usually help when stocks fall. But the correlation between the two isn't fixed: with high inflation and rising rates they can fall together, as in 2022.
Un derivato è un contratto il cui valore: A derivative is a contract whose value depends on another asset, the underlying: a stock, an index, a commodity, a currency. Options and futures are derivatives.
Un future obbliga entrambe le parti a co: A future obliges both parties to buy or sell an asset at a set price and date. It's settled every day through margins, so it uses leverage.
I future nacquero per la copertura: un p: Futures were born for hedging: a wheat farmer sells futures on the harvest to lock in today's price and reduce the risk of a fall, giving up any rise.
Leva, scadenze e prezzi che dipendono da: Leverage, expiry dates and prices that depend on several factors make derivatives hard: European authorities (ESMA) treat them as complex products.
Un'opzione call dà a chi la compra il di: A call option gives its buyer the right, not the obligation, to buy the underlying at a set price, the strike (exercise price), by a certain date. A put option gives the right to sell at the strike: it gains value when the underlying falls.
Il premio è il prezzo che chi compra l'o: The premium is the price the option's buyer pays its seller. The buyer's maximum loss is the premium paid: if exercising isn't worth it at expiry, they let it expire worthless.
Chi vende (scrive) un'opzione incassa il: Whoever sells (writes) an option collects the premium and takes on the obligation. Whoever writes a naked call, meaning without owning the stock, risks potentially unlimited losses if the price rises a lot: the premium is a small, fixed gain.
Una call è nel denaro (in the money) qua: A call is in the money when the price is above the strike, a put when it's below: exercising it right away would be worth something, the intrinsic value. Otherwise it's out of the money.
The rest of the premium is time value. As expiry nears there are fewer chances for the price to reach the strike, and that value wears away: it's time decay.
La volatilità implicita si ricava dal pr: Implied volatility is derived from the premium: it's how much future swing the market prices into the option. The wider the moves expected, the more options cost. It's an expectation, not a sure forecast.
Coprirsi (hedging) vuol dire usare un de: Hedging means using a derivative to reduce the risk of a position you already hold. It works like insurance: you pay a cost, for example a put's premium, to limit a loss.
Con un CFD o un'opzione l'esposizione pu: With a CFD or an option the exposure can be 10 times the capital put in: a 10% move against the position wipes out all the capital. Brokers' warnings remind you that most small investors trading CFDs lose money.
Il libro degli ordini (order book) è l'e: The order book is the list of pending buy and sell orders, price by price. On one side those who want to buy (bid), on the other those who want to sell (ask): the first level on each side defines the spread.
Prima dell'apertura c'è l'asta di apertu: Before the open there's the opening auction: orders are collected and the exchange sets a single starting price, the one that matches the most trades.

Il market maker propone di continuo prez: A market maker constantly quotes buy and sell prices: it earns the spread and in return provides liquidity, meaning it makes trading easier.
La liquidità di un titolo è quanto puoi: A stock's liquidity is how much you can buy or sell without moving the price much. Many buyers and sellers bring the best prices closer: heavily traded stocks have tight spreads. A company's liquidity, the cash in its coffers, is something else.
In un crollo improvviso gli spread si al: In a sudden crash spreads widen: whoever quotes prices takes on more risk, pulls back or asks for a bigger margin. Just when it's needed, liquidity dries up.
Il prezzo di un ETF in borsa segue doman: An ETF's market price follows supply and demand and can drift for a moment from the value of the basket it holds. Market makers bring it back by buying and selling, but in turbulent moments the gap can widen.
Le sessioni pre-market e after-hours son: Pre-market and after-hours sessions are trading outside regular hours: there are fewer orders and wider spreads, prices can jump and market orders can cost more.
Il volume dice quanto si è scambiato. Un: Volume tells you how much was traded. Very high volume means a lot of participation: many people bought and sold. It doesn't tell you which way prices will go in the following days.
La sospensione per volatilità (circuit b: A volatility halt (circuit breaker) is a temporary stop to trading after excessive moves in a stock or the index: it gives information and orders time to arrive before trading resumes.
